theme: hosts config file line surgery SET INSERT DROP FILELINE

tests.name: ghost_miss
tests.cmd: ghost path SET OK=0 REQUIRE exit 2

tests.name: neg_clamp
tests.cmd: SET/DROPFILELINE -1 clamps to 0 mutates first row

weaknesses.title: SET/DROPFILELINE negative index silently clamps to 0 and mutates first line
weaknesses.detail: SETFILELINE p -1 "Z" rewrites line 0 with OK=1 N=1. DROPFILELINE -1 drops first row. Worse than LINEAT read clamp — write ops destroy data on underflow.
weaknesses.repro: SYS SETFILELINE p -1 "Z" → L0 becomes Z

weaknesses.title: SETLINE/INSERTLINE/DROPNTH are bag ops; *FILELINE are disk ops
weaknesses.detail: Classic dual-family trap. SETLINE bag leaves file unchanged. Agents editing hosts on disk must use SETFILELINE not SETLINE.
weaknesses.repro: SETLINE bag 0 X; LINEAT file still old

weaknesses.title: SET/DROP OOB OK=1 N=0; INSERT past end succeeds as append
weaknesses.detail: Asymmetric: OOB set/drop soft-no-op; huge insert index remaps to TOTAL and writes. Agents treating any OK as "row idx honored" mis-place appends.

weaknesses.title: PRINT_JSON preview bag glues without NL
weaknesses.detail: # managed hosts10.0.0.1 api… recurring bag JSON collapse.

weaknesses.title: FILELINE rewrite may drop trailing NL on final file line
weaknesses.detail: After DROP/SET sequence, last hosts line often lacks final $ on cat -A. Same WRITE family gap for in-place rewrites.

weaknesses.title: Index args need (expr) form for bare numeric vars
weaknesses.detail: Same HEADFILE/LINEAT trap: SYS SETFILELINE p idx text fails parse unless (idx).
weaknesses.repro: SYS SETFILELINE p i "x" → unknown form

weaknesses.title: No dry-run / backup mode for destructive FILELINE ops
weaknesses.detail: SET/DROP mutate immediately. No SETFILELINE soft-preview. Hosts boards need agent-side copy first.

weaknesses.title: 0-based only; no 1-based hosts-line addressing
weaknesses.detail: Human line 1 is index 0. Recurring with LINEAT family.

workarounds: Use *FILELINE not bag SETLINE/INSERTLINE/DROPNTH for disk
Check op_n > 0 not only OK for OOB
Treat INSERT I vs requested idx as append remap signal
Copy file before surgery if rollback needed
language_gaps: Negative FILELINE index must miss/error not clamp-write
INSERT past-end should optionally fail instead of silent append
Dry-run / backup flag for FILELINE family
Trailing NL preserve on rewrite; PRINT_JSON bag-as-array
issues_faced: Neg index write clamp is critical footgun on live hosts files
INSERT 999 append asymmetry vs SET/DROP OOB
